summary: This bill automatically provides funding for the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to continue operations for up to 30 days during a government shutdown, ensuring essential air travel services are not interrupted.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly appropriates funds for the continued operation of the Federal Aviation Administration during a lapse in appropriations, ensuring spending continues for up to 30 days. This directly increases government spending during a shutdown scenario.

The bill directly appropriates whatever sums are needed to keep the FAA operating for up to 30 days during any lapse in regular appropriations, thereby authorizing additional spending to maintain a priority program rather than allowing operations to cease in order to avoid added borrowing.
